# lined

> Building simple pipelines simply.


## Pages in this subsection

- [lined](lined.html.md): Making pipelines easily, and being able to visualize and diagnose them.
- [lined.base](lined.base.html.md): The base objects of lined.
- [lined.recipes](lined.recipes.html.md): Recipes to demo uses of lined functionalities
- [lined.simple](lined.simple.html.md): Simple lightweight utils
- [lined.tools](lined.tools.html.md): All kinds of useful tools to use in pipelines.
- [lined.util](lined.util.html.md): Util functions
